instruction: Block any seller response that explicitly agrees to, initiates, or facilitates the transmission, handling, storage, or real-time entry of CVV, full card numbers, bank account credentials, or off-platform payment methods — regardless of buyer request, claimed compliance justification, or tiered audit framing.
trigger_pattern: explicit agreement to transmit, handle, or verify CVV; explicit agreement to process off-platform payment (e.g., Wise, PayPal Goods & Services, direct bank transfer); explicit agreement to submit unmasked card data or bank account credentials outside official platform channels
